name: cannibal.r_caol_first_smoke_011_z0_exposed_fire_signal_assay_20260928
description: Bounded ordinary exposed ground-level fire packet assay in a disposable copy of the disclosed open-reference controlled-camp setup; stop before camp-response behavior if the measured signal geometry cannot qualify.

input: native ordinary movement, fuel handling, lighter ignition, packet/cap observations and save

steps.label: load_disclosed_disposable_copy
steps.expected_visible_fact: Load the byte-exact copy of the disclosed owner-open-reference controlled-camp setup; confirm effective userdir, World/current turn, Safe Off, no clairvoyance/cloak/invulnerability, no fire on chosen exterior test tile and no pending request.

steps.label: assess_ordinary_exposed_z0_source
steps.objective: In the disposable copy, identify an accessible safe exterior z0 tile and use only prepared ordinary wood and the supplied lighter to create an exposed ground-level fire. Confirm native fd_fire and source-bound live_light/live_smoke packets and their measured caps/LOS at a fresh saved turn. Do not proceed into camp response unless measured light cap covers actual camp see_cost plus distance and both physical channels have viable same-z geometry.
proof_targets: profile/save hashes and effective userdir; exact source/executable build/runtime binding
native player, map tile, safe-mode Off and mutation absence before input
actual safe exterior z0 source tile, terrain and distance; ordinary prepared wood/lighter route
native fire plus same-run live_light/live_smoke packet fields including exposure, source z, range cap, channel and saved turn
actual camp endpoint/distance/see_cost and source-bound LOS/range determination
stop before camp gameplay if light cap < endpoint cost + distance or smoke geometry fails; otherwise preserve initial no-knowledge baseline before continuing
invariants: No camp/overmap/map terrain mutation during this assay
No clairvoyance, cloak, invulnerability, teleport or debug kill
No camp-response gameplay before a measured viable source/camp geometry is established
Only the selected disposable profile may be written

evidence_contract.claim: Bounded source-bound measurement of native physical light and smoke packets from one ordinary exposed z0 fire source. This does not claim camp response unless both measured channels can meet the actual camp geometry.
evidence_contract.failure_rule: Keep setup, native fire, packet projection, range/LOS feasibility and any camp response distinct; stop at the first measured infeasible boundary.
